title: [agent] Add status badge to README
body:
### Pre-flight checklist

- [x] This task has been discussed and approved by a maintainer (Discord or otherwise)
- [x] I understand this task will be implemented by an AI agent (Codex) and reviewed by an AI agent (Claude Code)
- [x] I understand a human maintainer must approve the plan before implementation begins

### Goal

Add a status badge to the README indicating the agent workflow pilot is active on this fork.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] README displays a badge with the text "AI Workflow"
- [ ] Badge links to the plan document
- [ ] Only README.md is modified

### Context / Background

This fork is used to develop and test the agent-driven development workflow.

### Constraints

- Only modify README.md
- Use English text

### Risk Level

risk:low — documentation, config, or cosmetic only

### Relevant Files or Modules

README.md

### Discussion or Approval Reference

https://discord.com/channels/example

### Scope Acknowledgment

- [x] This task does NOT involve authentication, authorization, secrets, database migrations, production config, release versioning, or branch protection changes
